profile.headline: Senior Mobile Softwear Engineer | Kotlin
profile.summary:
As an accomplished Senior Android Developer, my expertise lies in designing and delivering user-centric mobile solutions using Kotlin and Java. In my current role at Nametag Inc., I am focused on enhancing application functionality and robustness by implementing a credential wallet, refactoring navigation control flow, and integrating comprehensive testing tools like Mockk and Jacoco.

Previously, I honed my skills in ad technology at Admaru Network, where I developed the Admaru Mobile Monetization Service (AMMS) SDK. My extensive tenure as a Staff Android Developer at Samsung Electronics involved contributing to several high-impact projects, including the development of the Digital Home Key (UWB/BLE) in Samsung Wallet and advancing features for the Samsung Blockchain Wallet. Across all roles, I have a demonstrated history of driving innovation to build scalable, secure, and maintainable codebases for global products.

positions.title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer(Android)
positions.description:
Nametag Android App Development(Kotlin)
- Implemented Depenency Injection(Koin/Hilt)
- Implemented Mockk for Unit tests
- Implemented credential wallet
- Integrated JaCoCo test coverage tool
- Implemented retry/timeout logic for uploading big files.
- Released V5 version(UX improvement / RPC)
- Implemented WorkManager for uploading video asynchronously
- Completed Unit test coverage to 100%
- Implemented mandatory version update 
- Implemented the detection logic for GPS spoofing

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer(Android/Backend)
positions.locationName: Fort Lee, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Android(Kotlin)
• Developed guide and sample source for integrating Kakaotalk messenger and Admaru DSP.
• Developed Admaru app and SDK for prebid + GAM/Admob, utilizing MVVM, Page3, Flow, Room, Retrofit, Rest API.
• Developed sample source and a guide for getting ADID from the Webview in apps and provided them to publishers 

Backend(Java Spring)
• Implemented dynamic bid floor logic for the SSP, ensuring real-time multi-threading and thread safety. (Atomic / CAS)
• Implemented the scheduled report feature using Cron scheduler and Spring mail framework.
• Implemented SSP interworking with Motiv Intelligence DSP.
• Implemented Mezzo Media Targetpick 3.0 interworking in Admaru SSP.
• Implemented the Support board APIs of Admaru DSP for Kakao.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer(Android)
positions.description:
Technical leader of Digital Home Key Development for Samsung Pay & Wallet

(Role & Key Responsibilities)
Led to develop digital home key features in Samsung Pay & Wallet 
- Scrum master / Architecture reviewer / Issue gatekeeper
- Implemented key issue, key delete, door open, door close for ZigBang door lock 
- Refactoring the project with clean architecture 
- UWB / BLE / ESE / FiRa 

Led to develop Smart Contract Solutions for Samsung Mobile Blockchain
- Implemented ERC721(NFT: Non-Fungible Token) for Samsung Mobile Blockchain

Led to develop Permission Usage in Privacy/Settings (preloaded in Android12 mobiles)
- Scrum master / Architecture reviewer / Issue gatekeeper
- Architectured and implemented basic functionalities and UX.
- Implemented a content provider and resolver for working with the AppOps service framework
- Implemented an XML parser for synching with app permission DB.
- Implemented a job scheduler for periodical loading permission data from the framework DB file.
- Coworked with Google for this feature.

Led to develop whole features in Samsung Blockchain Wallet application 
- Scrum master / Architecture reviewer / Issue gatekeeper
- Led to develop and launched a version(1.2.07.46) interworking with Gemini exchange
- Led to develop and launched a version(1.2.08.9) interworking with Uppsala security
- Implemented DApp Search feature
- Implemented Banners and QIP(Quick Installation Panel) for DApp

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer(CP Protocol)
positions.description:
Developed Arm-based Qualcomm communication processor for Samsung Android Mobile Devices.
- AS(Access Stratum: RRC / PDCP / RLC / MAC / PHY) Protocol(LTE/5G/WCDMA) engineering

(Role & Key Responsibilities)
Analyzed and resolved market issues related to Tx/Rx call with logs in Samsung big data platform  
Resolved protocol issues such as call drop, call setup failure, call mute, data throughput, Inter-RAT handover, and so on 
Implemented the PLMN filter for distinguishing 5G support and parser for big data related to band information

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer(iOS)
positions.description:
- Led and developed iOS application services
  . Led and Developed Gear360 manager iOS app (Swift /Objective C)
  . Led development of Samsung Connect Auto(Prototype of Harman Dashcam) iOS app(Swift)
  
(Role & Key Responsibilities)
Led to develop Gear360 iOS App and implemented some features (LB, FOTA and so on).  
Developed iOS video engine for preview, saving and live broadcasting(Facebook, Youtube, and Periscope) of 360-degree videos and photos (OpenCV, OpenGL|ES, RTMP)
Led the development of SCA(Samsung Connect Auto) iOS Swift version. 
Developed vehicle health and push module of SCA.
Co-worked with Vietnam and Bangladesh labs regarding various features for SCA and Gear360.

positions.title: Software Engineer(Tandem Server)
positions.description:
- Developed financial Solutions
  . Client solutions for ATM 
  . Team’s webpage in Tandom server(Servlet, Html, SQL) 
  . Banking solution using Inter-Process Communication and TCP/IP on Tandem server

(Role & Key Responsibilities)
Developed and maintained solutions in financial servers(Tandem)
Developed new solutions(Webpage/TCP transaction app/ IPC module) in Tandem. 
Developed a test client for ATM(Windows) with Visual C++ and Visual Basic.
